responsibility: Parse the .pipe file DSL into a list of validated TaskDefinition objects covering params, run, success, requires, output, and timeout blocks.
non_responsibilities: Does not validate cross-task references or detect circular dependencies
Does not resolve parameter default values from environment variables at parse time
Does not execute tasks or shell commands
Does not load or parse the TOML config file

public_interface.name: parse
public_interface.description: Parse a .pipe file and return all task definitions it contains.
preconditions: file_path points to a readable file
postconditions: Each task block in the file is represented as exactly one TaskDefinition
Each task has at least one of run_block or requires_block set
Raises PipelineSyntaxError (exit 2) on any grammar violation
Raises PipelineSyntaxError if a param without a default follows one that has a default

responsibility: Load and validate the optional TOML config file into a typed PipelineConfig with defaults applied for any omitted keys.
non_responsibilities: Does not parse .pipe pipeline files
Does not validate task names referenced in the config against the pipeline
Does not execute tasks or resolve environment variable values dynamically

public_interface.name: load
public_interface.description: Load a TOML config file and return a PipelineConfig, or return defaults if no path is provided.
preconditions: file_path is None or points to a readable TOML file
postconditions: Returns PipelineConfig with entry defaulting to 'main' and clean_cwd defaulting to False
Raises PipelineSyntaxError (exit 2) on malformed TOML

responsibility: Parse and evaluate the expression language used in success criteria and requires block control flow, yielding boolean results or structured task invocation descriptors to the caller.
non_responsibilities: Does not execute shell commands or invoke tasks directly
Does not schedule or orchestrate task execution order
Does not parse the .pipe or TOML file formats
Does not write any output files or emit log lines

public_interface.name: evaluate_success
public_interface.description: Evaluate a single success criterion expression and return its boolean result.
preconditions: expr is a syntactically valid expression string
context contains stdout, stderr, and exit_code when the expression references them
postconditions: Returns True or False according to the expression semantics
Raises PipelineSyntaxError (exit 2) if the expression is malformed
Raises PipelineSyntaxError if a multiline expression lacks a return statement

public_interface.name: execute_requires
public_interface.description: Interpret the requires block sequentially, invoking the provided task callback for each task call encountered and returning whether all requirements were satisfied.
preconditions: block is the raw requires block string
task_callback executes a TaskInvocation synchronously and returns its JobResult
postconditions: Returns True if all required tasks satisfied their expected outcome
Returns False and stops early if an unconditional task call fails
Raises PipelineSyntaxError (exit 2) on malformed block syntax

responsibility: Execute the shell commands in a task's run block within a subprocess, capturing stdout, stderr, exit code, timeout status, and elapsed duration.
non_responsibilities: Does not evaluate success criteria expressions
Does not resolve requires dependencies
Does not emit event log lines
Does not write the jobs JSONL output file
Does not parse the .pipe or TOML file formats

public_interface.name: run
public_interface.description: Execute the run block commands in a subprocess and return the captured result.
preconditions: spec.output_dir, if set, resolves to a path within spec.workspace
postconditions: RunResult.stdout and RunResult.stderr contain only output from the run block commands
RunResult.exit_code is 124 and RunResult.timed_out is True when the timeout is exceeded
Unicode smart-quote characters (e.g. \u2018) are normalised to ASCII equivalents

responsibility: Orchestrate sequential DAG execution by resolving the entry task's requires chain, invoking each task in dependency order, evaluating success criteria, and collecting JobResult records.
non_responsibilities: Does not parse .pipe or TOML files
Does not execute shell commands directly (delegates to TaskRunner)
Does not evaluate expression language directly (delegates to ExpressionEvaluator)
Does not write output files or emit log lines (delegates to JobReporter)

public_interface.name: execute
public_interface.description: Run the pipeline from the entry task, executing all requires and run blocks in sequential dependency order and returning the full list of completed job results.
preconditions: entry task name exists in tasks
output_dir directory exists and is writable
postconditions: Returns one JobResult per job executed, ordered by job_id ascending
Entry task result is always the last record in the returned list
Raises InvalidPipeError (exit 3) on circular requires, undefined task references, type mismatches, missing required arguments, or output paths escaping the workspace
Recursive task calls raise InvalidPipeError (exit 3)

responsibility: Emit structured JSON event lines to stdout during execution and write the completed jobs.jsonl file to the output directory once execution finishes.
non_responsibilities: Does not execute tasks or evaluate expressions
Does not determine whether a task succeeded or failed
Does not parse .pipe or TOML files
Does not manage or influence execution order

public_interface.name: emit_event
public_interface.description: Write a single JSON event line to stdout immediately.
preconditions: event.event is one of TASK_STARTED, TASK_RUNNING, TASK_COMPLETED, TASK_FAILED
postconditions: A valid JSON line is flushed to stdout immediately
The line contains at least the 'event' and 'job_id' keys

public_interface.name: write_jobs_file
public_interface.description: Write all job results to a jobs.jsonl file in the specified output directory.
postconditions: jobs.jsonl is written with one JSON object per line per JobResult
Unicode smart-quote characters (e.g. \u2018) are replaced with ASCII equivalents in all string fields

responsibility: Parse command-line arguments and wire PipelineParser, ConfigLoader, DagExecutor, and JobReporter together to execute a pipeline, exiting with the appropriate status code.
non_responsibilities: Does not implement any pipeline parsing or execution logic
Does not evaluate expressions or run shell commands
Does not write job output files directly

public_interface.name: main
public_interface.description: Entry point: parse argv, orchestrate the full pipeline run, and return the appropriate exit code.
preconditions: argv contains the pipeline path, --workspace, and --output arguments
postconditions: Returns 0 if the entry task completed successfully
Returns 1 if the entry task failed
Returns 2 and writes SYNTAX_ERROR:<msg> to stderr on .pipe or TOML parse errors
Returns 3 and writes INVALID_PIPE:<msg> to stderr on semantic validation errors
